diagnostics.title: Large animated blur
diagnostics.message: Large animated blurs can use significant GPU memory on phones because blur(12px) gets heavier as the blur and element grow. Use a smaller blur or a smaller element.
diagnostics.help: Keep the blur under 10px, or blur a smaller element. Big blurs use a lot more GPU memory as the element grows

diagnostics.title: Secret-like public env variable
diagnostics.message: Client code references a public env variable whose name looks like a secret or privileged credential.
diagnostics.help: Public env prefixes are inlined into browser bundles. Rename public values to non-secret names, and keep tokens, passwords, private keys, and service-role credentials server-only.
